VBO:0201229.summary: The Shollie name is used here for a German Shepherd–Border Collie cross.
VBO:0201229.shortDescription: The Shollie name is used here for a German Shepherd–Border Collie cross.

sources.title: Vertebrate Breed Ontology — Shollie
sources.evidence: Pinned ontology explicitly gives German Shepherd Border Collie mix as exact synonym. Card says used here to avoid claiming every colloquial Shollie has this precise parentage.
